title: fagopyrum × heterocarpum
intro: Fagopyrum × heterocarpum, commonly known as buckwheat, is a pseudocereal plant that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of buckwheat include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, buckwheat is a rich source of dietary fiber, vitamins, and minerals, making it a valuable ingredient in health-promoting foods and dietary supplements.
